gizmo.title: Rubutun kiɗa
gizmo.description: Yana nunawa da kunna rubutun kiɗa, tab na guitar, da alamomin kiɗa ta alphaTex ko MusicXML.

configure.title: Alamomin AlphaTex
configure.description: Rubutun alphaTex a layi na rubutun kiɗan. Gyara kai tsaye don rubuta alamomi; ana ajiye shi a cikin samfuri don a kiyaye tazara.

configure.title: Fayil ɗin kiɗa
configure.description: Ɗora ko haɗa zuwa fayil ɗin MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) ko Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Yana maye gurbin alphaTex na layi idan an saita.

advanced.title: Kunna sauti
advanced.description: A kunne a matsayin tsoho - saurari rubutun kiɗan ta na'urar haɗa sauti da aka gina a ciki. Kashe don yanayin kallo kawai (babu sauti).

advanced.title: Nuna zaɓuɓɓukan nuni
advanced.description: Nuna maɓallan zuƙowa, miƙewa, da tsari a sandar mai kunnawa.

advanced.title: Nuna maɓallan fitarwa
advanced.description: Nuna maɓallan sauke MIDI da bugawa/PDF a sandar mai kunnawa.
